title: Best Street Photography Camera (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on the models cited in the cited sources (CNET, PCMag, and StreetBerlin) and their stated features. The Leica SL3‑P was chosen as the top pick because it appears in multiple sources and offers the highest resolution and fastest burst rate among the listed options.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost comparison is made.
